CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. Which response best shows understanding of Easter 3.0? (1 mark)
   A. Say Easter 3.0 has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Easter 3.0 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Easter 3.0 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Easter 3.0.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ.
   D. Say Miraculous catch of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
